featured_reviews.name: swati chandavarkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
An Exceptional Second Home for Our Son
We are incredibly fortunate to have found such a wonderful daycare for our son. Since he was 18 months old, the staff has cared for him as if it were his second home and they, his second mothers. His eagerness to go there every day, even on holidays, speaks volumes about the genuine love, understanding, and empathy they show each child in the parents' absence.
A significant aspect we value is the healthy and diverse meal program. The food is not only nutritious but also colorful and engaging, making meal times enjoyable. The staff's attentiveness is truly remarkable; they understand each child deeply, noticing even the slightest changes in their behavior.
Crucially, there is absolutely no screen time during meals, which was a top priority for us when selecting a daycare.
Hygiene standards are exceptionally high, reflecting their commitment to creating a safe and clean environment for the children. We also appreciate that the children have ample open space to move freely, which keeps them active, playful, and happy. The provision of small beds for afternoon naps is excellent, fostering independence in their sleeping habits.
Finally, the emphasis on teaching children to love and connect with their peers is incredibly touching. It's heartwarming to witness the children hugging and saying goodbye to their friends daily as they leave for home.
We feel truly lucky to have such a beautiful "second home" for our son. Our sincere gratitude goes out to the madam and all the staff for creating such a vibrant and nurturing environment for our children.

featured_reviews.name: Yuktha Tiwadi
featured_reviews.review_text: Narayana Schools are known for their focus on academic excellence and competitive exam preparation. Our daughter attends Narayana, and we appreciate the strong support from both teachers and management. While the infrastructure may not match that of Witty, the academic focus and commitment to studies are exceptional. I recommend this school solely for students who express an interest in pursuing a career in Engineering or Medicine after the 10th grade.

featured_reviews.name: Meenakshi Anurag Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Narayana fees staff in IC Colony borivali west very rude and non cooperative
They give a specific time to come and pay fees and when we reach they make us wait even if no line. It seems that lady is doing favour to us by accepting our fees.
No one was there to take complaint.
Would appreciate if the management takes good decision of time mangement  and teach staff to value others time.

featured_reviews.name: Santosh Kanchan
featured_reviews.review_text: worst school in borivli . please dont even think of putting your kids here. its  not a school its a business house more interested in earning profits and least interest in education.  The way they teach is really pathetic and they are least responsible to check if the kid is able to undertand what has been taught. the online classes have been a disaster where they merged classes to save time. kids are not given opportunity to clarify doubts. they have not reduced the fees even in pandemic but they have reduced teachers fees into half. they have no moral values plus have no mission or vision as an organization.  Their only vision is triple their profits with third class education they provide.

featured_reviews.name: Sreekanth Varma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Narayana for enquiry reg admissions. Unlike other schools the admission process is non bureaucratic and one can always walk in without the hassles of calling a long wait time helpline, taking appointment etc. The fee structure is transparent and properly communicated.

Edit: The school has commenced offline classes and the schedule is tightly packed with lot of activities for children. There is an all-round development in the children.
